education.level: Bachelor of Technology (Electronics and Communication Engineering)

workExperience.description:
Engineered a full-stack peer-to-peer lending platform supporting role-based dashboards, scalable APIs, and secure
workflows.
Implemented authentication using JWT and Google OAuth with Passport.js, enhancing session security and access
control.
Built robust RESTful APIs for loan management, interest calculation, repayment tracking, and transaction summaries.
Decreased overdue repayments by 30% via automated email alerts using cron jobs and Nodemailer.
Developed a modular, responsive frontend with React and Tailwind CSS, improving maintainability and user experience.

Developed a dual-role platform enabling applicants to upload resumes and HRs to filter candidates by keyword relevance.
Integrated Elasticsearch for fast, full-text resume search with scoring logic for skill-based filtering.
Collaborated on NLP-based resume parsing for keyword extraction, improving recruiter efficiency in shortlisting.
Designed animated, drag-and-drop resume upload with real-time feedback using React.js and Tailwind CSS.
Implemented JWT-secured APIs with role-based middleware, ensuring secure and scoped access to resources.
